identity.name: **Calcium-Opus-20B-v1**
identity.summary: Calcium-Opus-20B-v1 is a 20B-parameter model built on the Qwen 2.5 architecture, intended to strengthen reasoning capabilities.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: text-generation model intended to strengthen reasoning with no reported evaluation of factual grounding -> plausible hallucination risk

possible_risks.description: AI, and large generative models in particular, might produce increased carbon emissions and increase water usage for their training and operation.
possible_risks.justification: 20B-parameter dense decoder-only model trained/operated at scale with no reported environmental metrics -> plausible environmental impact

possible_risks.description: Determining who is responsible for an AI model is challenging without good documentation and governance processes. The use of synthetic data in model development adds further complexity, since the lack of standardized frameworks for recording synthetic data design choices and verification steps makes accountability harder to establish.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight checkpoint built on Qwen 2.5 with only a brief card and no governance details -> accountability hard to establish

specifications.model_size: 35.7 GiB of safetensors weights (38,346,130,104 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The model card describes Calcium-Opus-20B-v1 as based on the Qwen 2.5 modality architecture and aimed at enhancing reasoning in 20B-parameter models.
training_context.training_data: The model card states that the model has improved knowledge, coding, and mathematics capabilities due to specialized expert models in those domains.
